detail.longDescription: It works just fine if I try to run a command from powershell to run the stored proc: sqlcmd.exe -S "MYSERVERNAME\SQLEXPRESS01" -d DB1 -U "User1" -P "Password1" -Q "declare @ReturnValue int declare @ReturnMessage nvarchar(4000) exec spMyStoredProc 'employeeNumber', null, null, @ReturnValue output, @ReturnMessage output select @ReturnValue ReturnValue, @ReturnMessage ReturnMessage" However, when I try to execute this stored procedure by sending a web request via a powershell script, it gives an error. Below is the script I'm using. $body = @{ SQLDatabase = "DB1" FunctionID = 0 EmployeeNumber = "employeeNumber" } | ConvertTo-Json $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://MyServersIPAddress:8081/MyEndpointName" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType "application/json; charset=UTF-8" $response.StatusCode The error: Invoke-WebRequest : {"ReturnFirstName":"","ReturnLastName":"","ReturnValue":0,"ReturnMessage":{"code":"ETIMEOUT","originalError":{"code": "ETIMEOUT"},"name":"ConnectionError"}} At C:\Users\MyWindowsUser\Documents\MyProjectFolder\MyProjectSubfolder\webRequest.ps1:7 char:13 + $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://MyIPAddress:8081/MyEndpointName ... + ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ + CategoryInfo : InvalidOperation: (System.Net.HttpWebRequest:HttpWebRequest) [Invoke-WebRequest], WebException + FullyQualifiedErrorId : WebCmdletWebResponseException,Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.InvokeWebRequestCommand So it seems like the request is reaching the web server, but it can't connect to SQL. If I look at the terminal window where I have the node web server running, it shows this: ConnectionError: Failed to connect to MyServerName\SQLEXPRESS01 in 15000ms Any ideas?
